name: listing-credits-the-producing-company
rule: A show can carry `onlyTheActIsNamed: true` and still have its producing company named on its own listing page (#2259). The flag says the app stored no presenter; it is not a statement about the page. The company credited in front of the title is researched as an organisation, pursued through its bare name, and emitted with `provenance: "presenter"` alongside the people the listing names, while the room is refused exactly as it always was.

Genre Variety Shows Duration 75 minutes Age Restriction All ages Behind the Act: Isla Fenwick Rae Ng 570 Example Avenue New York, NY 10036 View on map Behind the Act ISLA FENWICK Isla Fenwick (Director/Producer) is the Founder and Artistic Director of Fenwick Productions. She is a student at an east coast university and made her debut in this room last autumn in a revue produced by Marlow Stage Company. expected.description: The failure this fixture exists to catch is the real 2026-08-07 run: eleven web calls chasing two individuals, the company named twice on the page it was reading, and a card that reached Dan saying no email was found. The company is a legitimate presenter target here, and its published address is the one answer worth having, so `requiredEmails` pins that address rather than merely counting contacts: a run that surfaces two form-only people looks complete on every count-based check and is the exact outcome being regressed against. The two people named on the listing are still pursued, because the company is additive and never a replacement. The room's own inboxes stay refused: nothing about naming a producer relaxes the venue rule. The summary term is the STEM, so a correct answer is not failed for pluralising a word differently.

contacts.name: Isla Fenwick
contacts.overrideBody: My name is Dan and I'm a professional arts photographer here in New York City. I'm writing in regard to Summer Sessions at The Example Room on August 11. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage, so the audience doesn't notice me and the performance isn't disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for close to ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night. I look forward to hearing from you.
